assessment: This study addresses mechanisms by which bacteria are able to survive and evade killing by antibiotics. Using fluorescent versions of antibiotics it studies whether entry/efflux of the drug itself is a significant contributor to the observed variability of antibiotic activity. This study will be of interest to microbiologists and clinicians for the design of better antibiotic therapies and improves our understanding of the relationships between drug uptake, bacterial growth, and drug efficacy.
